received_works.body:
Nice to meet you.
I love the illustrations of men and women that Shiru-san draws, and I really wanted you to draw my two original characters, so I’m placing this commission.

[Character 1]
Gender: Female
Personality: She’s a bit of a mama’s girl and loves to sleep. She also has a mischievous side.
Hairstyle: Long, loose, wavy hair in a natural brown shade that reaches around her shoulder blades.
Eyes: Pale blue-green, slightly drooping eyes.
Mole: One on the left side of her mouth.
Image Color: Pale blue-green

[Character 2]
Gender: Male
Personality: A reliable and kind adult in public, but a super clingy older brother who acts like a big puppy when he’s around the person he likes. He’s very affectionate out of love and often has a doting expression when he’s with his younger sister.
Hairstyle: Black hair, slightly longer with a part slightly toward the center.
Eyes: Deep grayish dark brown, droopy eyes.
Mole: One on the left side of the neck.
Image Color: Milky white

Relationship: Codependent step-siblings.

I would be happy if you could draw them however you like, Shiru-san.

Permitted Uses
・Creating fan art for personal enjoyment
・Using as reference material for future character development

If the details don’t suit you, please feel free to cancel.
I apologize for the inconvenience, but I would appreciate your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H3V8HcjofX8hgFTbO5fNTpJ7XiP0WBTN

Thank you for your continued support. Nice to meet you! 🙇🏻‍♀️ I've always loved your work and reached out hoping you might consider creating an illustration for me. 🙇🏻‍♀️🙇🏻‍♀️

The black-haired girl has a tsundere personality. She rarely smiles and usually has a cool, expressionless demeanor. The blue-haired boy has a very gentle personality and always has a faint smile on his face. A key point is that the boy has a small rabbit with him. For the image of the rabbit sitting on his shoulder, please refer to the attached picture!

I plan to use this artwork as my personal computer wallpaper!! 🥰🥰 If possible, I'd like to leave the composition and poses up to you! If any part of my description is unclear, please feel free to draw it as you see fit. 🙇🏻‍♀️🙇🏻‍♀️

Thank you for your consideration. I truly appreciate you reading this long message all the way through. I would be so grateful if you could take a look! 💕💕🙇🏻‍♀️🙇🏻‍♀️ https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1U6bz8YYdzileGSAeAaItf1s2Up9Vx083

Hi! Your art is really pretty, and I would love to commission you for my OC.

Her name is Suji, a snake hybrid with a snake tail and tongue. She always has a gentle smile and quietly observes everything around her. She tends to stare without blinking, which can feel a little creepy, but she’s calm, polite, and composed.

Feel free to choose whichever outfit you’d like to draw her in!

Thank you for your time and consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1or4tA__ADOg21AsgkrYvhmGE6jtHIbXa?usp=sharing
